choices.label: Visualization of the Body: the physical ability score

Visualization of the Body.descriptionOnly: Constitution: hit points equal to its Hit Dice; spent early: 1d8 + character level hit points, a +4 dodge bonus to AC for 3 rounds, or +6 on Strength checks to break objects and grapple checks for 1 minute, told here

choices.label: Visualization of the Mind: the mental ability score

Visualization of the Mind.descriptionOnly: spent early: a +2 luck bonus on d20 rolls for 1 minute, ranks for 1 minute, or a Will save again at +4, told here
